pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Modes of preservation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Modes of preservation of the Qur’an.
   B. Apply the teaching of Modes of preservation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Modes of preservation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Modes of preservation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in revealed scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in revealed scriptures has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in revealed scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Belief in revealed scriptures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in revealed scriptures.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah.
   C. Use Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj and Umrah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hajj and Umrah has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hajj and Umrah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj and Umrah.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Ulul-Azm Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ulul-Azm Prophets has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Ulul-Azm Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Ulul-Azm Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulul-Azm Prophets.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue.
   D. Use Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected verses has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected verses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T? (1 mark)
   A. Use Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T.
   D. Say Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Commanding good and forbidding evil? (1 mark)
   A. Use Commanding good and forbidding evil to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Commanding good and forbidding evil.
   C. Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Commanding good and forbidding evil has no place in daily life.

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Commanding good and forbidding evil and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues in Islam promise management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. B — Apply the teaching of Modes of preservation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. B — Apply the teaching of Belief in revealed scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. D — Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

6. B — Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. C — Apply the teaching of Ulul-Azm Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. C — Apply the teaching of Selected verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. B — Apply the teaching of Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. C — Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Telling the truth and keeping trust

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Commanding good and forbidding evil; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Virtues in Islam promise management; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Prohibitions in Islam; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
